posts.headline: Forty-eight editions deep and Thicks still hasn't earned a syllable of respect — Klint's Clipboard is 6-2 but 934.5 points-for remains the lightest scoring resume ever attached to a ring in this league.
posts.detail: A title in 2025 means nothing when your current roster is outscored by half the league; 934.5 points-for is pedestrian for a six-win contender with that kind of pedigree.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers just keep climbing — 1128.92 points-for is now the biggest total in Busters Anonymous and triciagloston isn't a sleeper anymore, she's the standard.
posts.detail: At 6-2 with a career record that started 6-7-1 just last year, this is the fastest ascent in the league and nobody's talking about it enough.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is still rotting at 2-6 and the greatest résumé in league history — a 20-8 career record and 1.5 average finish — is now an full-blown embarrassment.
posts.detail: Two titles' worth of pedigree and 874.16 points-for can't save a season that's forty-eight editions deep in collapse; the crater just keeps getting deeper.

posts.headline: Sasinci is stuck at 4-4 and Big Head's title defense has been dead so long it's basically a cold case file now.
posts.detail: A champion with a 13-15 career record and 905.74 points-for this year has no business hovering at .500 — Megamind's reign is officially a memory.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is 2-6 with a league-worst 787.26 points-for, and Auntie Thomas is proving there's no easy way out of the bottom-feeder tier.
posts.detail: A career 6-8 record and dead-last average finish of 10 set the bar, and this year's 2-6 start with the league's lowest scoring total is right on brand.
